beats.event: Kannagi marries Kovalan; they live in bliss in wealthy Puhar
Kovalan meets the courtesan Madhavi and abandons Kannagi
He squanders his wealth on Madhavi while Kannagi waits chastely
At Indra's festival a sung poem breeds mutual suspicion
Kovalan returns; Kannagi forgives and welcomes him
Impoverished, the couple journeys to Madurai
Kannagi gives Kovalan an anklet to sell for starting capital
A jeweller frames Kovalan as thief of the queen's anklet
The Pandya king executes Kovalan without proper trial
Kannagi hears of her husband's death
In court she splits her anklet: rubies, not the queen's pearls
The king recognizes his error and dies of shame
She tears off her breast; a curse burns Madurai to the ground
She wanders to Chera country; Indra receives her to heaven
King Cheran Chenkuttuvan enthrones her as the goddess Pattini
